items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And we had Paul on piano and Mark Hannah(?) on the drums.

ctx.x: I don't know how he learned it. But this man was a very wise man. Very wise. He had a great mind, you know. And I imagine he learned it pretty much himself, you know. But he was far, far ahead of his time -- Mark Hannah(?). A very, very brilliant man.

Of course, the band changed personnel. At different periods, they had different guys come in. It changed. And I'd like to mention a couple of guys who were spectacular. You know, so many people got overlooked during that period, you know.
